doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Curly and Willie B with the steel guitar
summary: Corley recalls jug player Curly and Willie B on steel guitar, with whom he played.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Well, let's see now. Who else were you thinking about, Dewey? That sounded good. You have any good jug players around? Now, let's see.

Well, let me see. We had another boy. Little jug pretty good around here. Boy called Curly. He died. Other boy used to play with him with a guitar. I called Willie B. He played steel guitar. They were good. I played with them.
What's a steel guitar look like?
Oh, it's a shirt. Shined like his cup. Shined like that cup that girl got there.
